0022600202.text: The Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home) host the Miami Heat (3-6) in Sacramento's 10th game of the season, with Sacramento 15th in the West and 6.5 games back in the Pacific after losing their last two. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Domantas Sabonis (out, knee soreness; 15.3 points and 35.5 minutes per game this season), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee; 12.5 points and 26.5 minutes per game last season). Miami, ninth in the East and three games back in the Southeast, has lost its last game, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1 and with the Kings losing the last meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20.
